# Home Security Intelligence

> AI-powered home security monitoring with real-time object detection and LLM-based risk analysis. Self-hosted, privacy-first. Fully containerized with GPU passthrough.

## For AI Assistants (Cursor, Claude, etc.)

This file provides deployment and architecture context for LLM-powered coding assistants.

**Uplevel programme in progress (2026-10):** before changing code, tests, compose, CI or docs, read `docs/uplevel/README.md` — lanes, packages and the PR contract. Mutation testing follows `docs/uplevel/01-mutation-policy.md`.

**Key entry points:**
- `docker-compose.prod.yml` - Container orchestration (core + monitoring stack; `ai-gateway` is the detection entrypoint, `ai-vlm` the shipped reasoning engine)
- `backend/` - Python FastAPI backend (REST API, WebSocket, AI pipeline)
- `frontend/` - React TypeScript dashboard (Tailwind + Tremor)
- `ai/` - AI service code (`ai/gateway/` serves detection via Triton — routers `/yolo26` + `/enrich-lt` only since R8 S3; `ai/vlm/` is the shipped llama.cpp `ai-vlm` engine. The retired `ai/nemotron/` serving dir was deleted in R8 S2)

**Architecture:**
```
Cameras (FTP) --> FileWatcher --> YOLO26 --> Batch Aggregator --> ai-vlm --> Dashboard
                                (via ai-gateway :8090)          (llama.cpp :8098)
```

## Quick Deploy (First Time)

```bash
# 1. Clone repository
git clone https://github.com/mikesvoboda/nemotron-v3-home-security-intelligence.git
cd nemotron-v3-home-security-intelligence

# 2. Configure environment (setup.py generates .env interactively; or copy the template)
python setup.py            # or: cp .env.example .env

# 3. Download AI models (~763MB per the setup_lib download rule — see AI Models below; the shipped VLM's GGUF pair is operator-placed config, not fetched here)
./ai/download_models.sh

# 4. Start all services (builds AI containers on first run; the shipped ai-vlm
#    engine is in the default set, so no profile flag is needed)
podman-compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml up -d

# 5. Wait for AI models to load (~2-3 min)
watch -n 5 'curl -s http://localhost:8000/api/system/health/ready'
```

**Access:** https://localhost:8444 (Dashboard, nginx container; plain HTTP on host 8080 for tunnel setups) | http://localhost:8000/docs (API)

> First launch requires admin registration: `SetupGuardMiddleware` returns 503 on most API routes until the first user is created via the browser setup flow.

## Updating a Deployment

CI publishes pre-built frontend/backend containers to GitHub Container Registry (the `:latest` pointer moves only after the deploy smoke test passes). The AI services are never published there — `ai-gateway` and `ai-vlm` build locally from `docker-compose.prod.yml` (`ai/gateway/Dockerfile` and `./ai/vlm`), which since the O1.2 retirement is the only application compose file the repository ships.

```bash
# Update the checkout the stack builds from
git pull

# Rebuild what changed (omit the service args to rebuild everything)
podman-compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml build ai-gateway ai-vlm

# Restart everything
podman-compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml down
podman-compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml up -d
```

## GPU Requirements

| VRAM | Capability | Example GPUs |
|------|------------|--------------|
| **24GB** | Full stack, all models loaded | RTX 3090, 4090, A5000, A5500, A6000 |
| **16GB** | Reduced GPU layers (`VLM_GPU_LAYERS`) | RTX 4080, A4000 |
| **8GB**  | `ai-vlm` partly in system RAM, slower verdict on the same card | RTX 3070, 4060 Ti |

**VRAM budget:** the shipped `ai-vlm` engine's model identity is operator config (`VLM_MODEL_PATH`/`VLM_MMPROJ_PATH` in `.env`; `.env.example` defaults to `Qwen3VL-8B-Instruct-Q4_K_M`, see `.env.example` / the bring-up record — measured on the 24 GB A5500: 9,606 MiB whole-stack peak, 9,826 MiB at the slot ceiling, ledger items 39-40). The retired 30B Nemotron path's ~14.7GB on-disk / ~21GB resident figures are dead with it. Gateway Triton models are resident (`--model-control-mode=none`); backend-zoo models become resident at boot when `BACKEND_MODEL_PRELOAD=true` — nothing loads them on demand at runtime, and nothing evicts (the zoo has no eviction pass — `priority`/`never_evict` rows are parsed but have no consumer). `VLM_GPU_LAYERS` (default `auto`) fits the engine to available VRAM.

## AI Models (~763MB downloaded by the setup_lib rule — 5 entries of the 10 live `models.yml` rows)

The download script (`./ai/download_models.sh`) fetches the models the shared
rule selects (`download_method != "skip" AND (hf_repo OR download_method)`, the
same filter `setup_lib/models_config.get_downloadable_models` uses):

| Model | Size | Purpose |
|-------|------|---------|
| YOLO26 (n/s/m .pt) | ~67MB | Object detection (gateway Triton export input) |
| Threat-Detection-YOLOv8n | ~25MB | Weapon detection (Triton `threat`) |
| OSNet-AIN x1.0 | ~10MB | Person re-ID (Triton `reid`) |
| YOLO11 face | ~11MB | Face detection on person crops |
| YOLO11 license-plate | ~650MB | Plate detection |

R8 (slices S1-S3, 2026-09-29) retired the ~32GB legacy zoo this section used to
list — the Nemotron GGUF, Florence x2, SigLIP/CLIP, fashion-clip, vehicle, pet,
depth, age/gender, weather, violence, smoke-fire, pose, segformer, stgcn,
yolo-world. The shipped reasoning engine is the `ai-vlm` llama.cpp
container; its GGUF pair is operator config (`VLM_MODEL_PATH`+`VLM_MMPROJ_PATH`
under `${AI_MODELS_PATH}/vlm`), fetched by no script — see the download script's
header note.

### Custom Model Path

Default installation path: `/export/ai_models`

To use a custom path:
```bash
# Set before running download script
export AI_MODELS_PATH=/your/custom/path
./ai/download_models.sh

# Also set when starting containers
AI_MODELS_PATH=/your/custom/path podman-compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml up -d
```

### Directory Structure (after download)

```
${AI_MODELS_PATH}/
├── vlm/                               # operator-placed GGUF pair (VLM_MODEL_PATH + VLM_MMPROJ_PATH)
└── model-zoo/
    ├── yolo26/                        # Detection (n/s/m .pt; gateway export)
    ├── osnet-ain-x1-0/                # Person re-ID (Triton reid)
    ├── threat-detection-yolov8n/      # Weapons (Triton threat)
    ├── yolo11-face-detection/         # Faces
    └── yolo11-license-plate/          # License plates
```

## Services & Ports

Host port defaults come from `.env` / `.env.example`; `docs/reference/config/env-reference.md` is the env-variable reference (its six tabled port vars are `API_PORT`, `SMTP_PORT`, the frontend HTTP/HTTPS/INTERNAL set and `SYNTHBENCH_COMFYUI_PORT` — no AI or monitoring service ports; those host-port vars below come from `.env.example`).

### Core Services

| Service | Host Port | Container | GPU | Description |
|---------|-----------|-----------|-----|-------------|
| Frontend HTTPS | 8444 | frontend | No | React dashboard via nginx (internal 8443) |
| Frontend HTTP | 8080 | frontend | No | nginx HTTP for Cloudflare tunnel / Brev link (internal 8080) |
| Backend | 8000 | backend | Reserved, 0 MiB measured | FastAPI REST + WebSocket (compose reserves 1 nvidia GPU; torch is the CPU build) |
| PostgreSQL | 5432 | postgres | No | Event/detection storage |
| Redis | 6379 | redis | No | Queues and pub/sub |
| go2rtc API | 1984 | go2rtc | No | Stream management API |
| go2rtc WebRTC | 8555 | go2rtc | No | Browser WebRTC streaming |
| AI Gateway | 8090 | ai-gateway | Yes | Triton routers: `/yolo26` `/enrich-lt` only (R8 S3 pruned the rest) |
| ai-vlm | 8098 | ai-vlm | Yes | llama.cpp reasoning engine, in the default compose set (starts with plain `up -d`) |
| vLLM (optional) | 8097 | ai-llm-vllm | Yes | Compose profile `vllm`, benchmarking harness, off by default |

> Since commit bc7d6101 the standalone YOLO26/Florence/CLIP/enrichment containers are gone, and R8 S1-S3 (2026-09-29) retired the legacy `ai-llm` service (:8091) plus the `/florence` `/clip` `/enrichment` gateway routers — `GATEWAY_MODEL_SET` only resolves `vlm` (yolo26 + reid, threat opt-in) and hard-raises on anything else. The legacy `YOLO26_PORT=8095` and `LLM_PORT=8091` values still in `.env.example` are reference/dev stand-ins with no prod-compose consumer (`YOLO26_PORT` is read by `ai/start_detector.sh`; `FLORENCE_PORT`, `CLIP_PORT`, `ENRICHMENT_PORT` and `ENRICHMENT_LIGHT_PORT` have since been removed from `.env.example`). `FRONTEND_PORT=5173` is likewise no longer mapped by prod compose.

### Monitoring Services

| Service | Port | Description |
|---------|------|-------------|
| Prometheus | 9090 | Metrics collection |
| Grafana | 3002 | Dashboards (proxied at /grafana via nginx) |
| Tempo | 3200 | Distributed tracing (replaces Jaeger) |
| Loki | 3100 | Log aggregation |
| Pyroscope | 4040 | Continuous profiling |
| Alertmanager | 9093 | Alert routing |
| Alloy | 12345 | Log/metrics collector UI |
| Redis Exporter | 9121 | Redis metrics |
| JSON Exporter | 7979 | Custom metrics |
| Node / DCGM / Blackbox exporters | 9100 / 9400 / 9115 | Host, GPU, endpoint metrics |

## Common Commands

```bash
# Start all services (the shipped ai-vlm engine is in the default set)
podman-compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml up -d

# View logs
podman-compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml logs -f backend
podman-compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml logs -f ai-vlm

# Check health
curl http://localhost:8000/api/system/health/ready

# Stop services
podman-compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml down

# GPU memory check
nvidia-smi

# Database shell
podman exec -it $(podman ps -qf name=postgres) psql -U security -d security
```

## Updating from the main branch

CI's published `:latest` containers (GitHub Container Registry) exist for the CI
smoke stack and manual inspection — the deployment stack builds its own images
from source, so a pull changes nothing it runs. Update the checkout and rebuild:

```bash
git pull

# Redeploy (add service names to rebuild only what changed)
podman-compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml build
podman-compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml down
podman-compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml up -d
```

## Auto-Start on Boot

| Platform | Command |
|----------|---------|
| Linux (systemd) | `./scripts/setup-systemd.sh` |
| macOS (launchd) | `./scripts/setup-launchd.sh` |
| Windows (Task Scheduler) | `powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\setup-windows.ps1` |

## Troubleshooting

**Container won't start (port in use):**
```bash
ss -tlnp | grep 8000  # Find what's using the port
```

**GPU not available:**
```bash
podman run --rm --device nvidia.com/gpu=all nvidia/cuda:12.4-base nvidia-smi
```

**Out of VRAM:**
```bash
# In .env: reduce the ai-vlm engine's GPU layers (default: auto = fit to VRAM)
VLM_GPU_LAYERS=30
```

**AI service slow/not responding:**
```bash
curl http://localhost:8090/health  # AI gateway
curl http://localhost:8098/health  # ai-vlm (host port = AI_VLM_PORT)
# First request after startup is slow (model loading)
```

## Project Structure

```
nemotron-v3-home-security-intelligence/
├── docker-compose.prod.yml   # Container orchestration
├── backend/                  # FastAPI backend
│   ├── api/routes/          # REST + WebSocket endpoints
│   ├── services/            # AI pipeline, file watcher
│   └── models/              # SQLAlchemy models
├── frontend/                 # React dashboard
│   └── src/
│       ├── components/      # UI components
│       ├── hooks/           # WebSocket + data hooks
│       └── services/        # API client
├── ai/                       # AI service code
│   ├── gateway/             # Detection entrypoint :8090 (routers /yolo26 + /enrich-lt only, R8 S3)
│   ├── yolo26/              # Detection contract leaf + host-run dev server (prod serving is Triton inside gateway; its code lives in ai/gateway/)
│   ├── vlm/                 # Shipped llama.cpp ai-vlm engine (host port AI_VLM_PORT, default 8098)
│   └── triton/ common/ shared/  # Triton client + model repository and shared code
└── docs/                     # Documentation
```
